note: Both sets extract the same core engineering claims with high accuracy and coverage. The primary difference lies in the consistency of attribute naming for the display size claims. Set A consistently uses 'minimum manufacturer stated display size' for all four display claims (TV and Computer, in inches and cm). Set B is inconsistent, using 'minimum manufacturer stated display size' for the inch values but 'minimum size' (with the qualifier moved to conditions) for the cm values. Set A's approach is more structured and faithful to the text's phrasing across all instances.
remarks: Both sets duplicate the display size facts by extracting inches and centimeters as separate claims; while not wrong, it creates redundancy. Set B's inconsistency in attribute naming for these duplicate claims ('minimum size' vs 'minimum manufacturer stated display size') is a minor quality issue compared to Set A's consistency.
